<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2 and the molecular formula C12H13O3 (C=12, H=13, N=0, X=0), the calculation yields DBE = (24 + 2 - 13)/2 = 13/2 = 6.5. DBE must be an integer for neutral molecules, so the nearest whole number is 6.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
